item.title: Ulster County officials disapprove of EPA change to reduce energy regulations
item.description: Ulster County officials condemned the Trump administration’s move this week to revoke the Environmental Protection Agency’s 2009 “endangerment finding,” which is the legal basis for most federal limits on greenhouse-gas pollution.
